```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-reconciliation-summary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-reconciliation-summary`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): see rename_legacy_antibiotic_table() in
# this report's _setup.qmd. A dataset serialized before neoipcr 0.0.0.9007,
# or calculated from a raw dataset written before it, carries no
# reconciliation summary, and one imported with the reconciliations switched
# off carries an empty one; a sentence says which, for the department's data
# and for the reference data alike. Without the first case such a file would
# be described as built with the reconciliations switched off, when it
# predates them.
reconciliation_strings <- sR$`tbl-reconciliation-summary`
reconciliation_shown <- compared_summaries(
  own = benchmark_data$reconciliationSummary$own,
  ref = benchmark_data$reconciliationSummary$ref,
  has_reference = "ref" %in% benchmark_data$dataset_names,
  own_notes = c(
    absent = reconciliation_strings$own_not_recorded,
    empty  = reconciliation_strings$own_not_reconciled),
  reference_notes = c(
    absent = reconciliation_strings$reference_not_recorded,
    empty  = reconciliation_strings$reference_not_reconciled),
  zero_notes = c(
    own       = reconciliation_strings$own_no_reconciliations,
    reference = reconciliation_strings$reference_no_reconciliations,
    both      = reconciliation_strings$both_no_reconciliations),
  sR = sR)
reconciliation_notes <- reconciliation_shown$notes
if (length(reconciliation_shown$summaries) == 0L) {
  # No dataset has a summary to show: the department's sentence takes the
  # table's place, and the reference data's follows it.
  no_data_table(reconciliation_notes[1])
  reconciliation_notes <- reconciliation_notes[-1]
} else {
  tbl <- format_reconciliation_summary_table(
    reconciliation_shown$summaries, sR, font_size = summary_table_font_size)
  if (is.null(tbl))
    no_data_table(reconciliation_shown$zero_note)
  else
    tbl
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# A dataset without a summary of its own contributes no column group; the
# reader is told why rather than left to wonder.
for (note in reconciliation_notes)
  cat("\n", note, "\n", sep = "")
```
